### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines?

### 2.0 Import data

- Read differentially expressed genes 

```{r}

differentially_expressed_events_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "01-differentially-expressed-events-pvalue-lt-0.05.csv"))

```

### Frequency of differential expression

```{r}

frequency_df <- as.data.frame(table(differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast, differentially_expressed_events_df$direction))
colnames(frequency_df) <- c("contrast", "direction", "frequency")
frequency_df <- frequency_df[!(frequency_df$contrast %in% c("effect_of_erap2_kd_in_als_vs_ctrl", "genetic_effect_of_als")),]
frequency_df$contrast <- factor(frequency_df$contrast, levels = c("als_vs_ctrl", "erap2_kd_effect_in_control", "erap2_kd_effect_in_als"))
prop_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(frequency_df, frequency_df$contrast), function(x){
    x <- x[rev(order(x$direction)),]
    x$prop <- x$frequency / sum(x$frequency)
    x$lab_y <-  cumsum(x$prop) - (0.5 * x$prop)
    return(x)
}))

```

- Plot frequency plots

```{r}

require("ggplot2")

my_theme <- theme(legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1, angle = 45),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed", size = 0.2))

Colours <- c("up" = "#D81E5B", "down" = "#3993DD")
the_plot <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = contrast, y = prop))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_col(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000")
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_text(data = prop_df, aes(x = contrast, y = lab_y, label = frequency), colour = "#000000")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_x_discrete("comparisons")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_y_continuous("log10 frequency of differential expression")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_fill_manual("lfc direction", values = Colours)
the_plot <- the_plot + theme_bw()
the_plot <- the_plot + my_theme
ggsave(the_plot, file = file.path(plot_dir, "01-01-plot-frequency-of-differential-expression.pdf"), height = 9, width = 3)

```


- Plot venn diagram of contrasts


```{r}

require("ggvenn")
require("cowplot")


als_vs_contrl_up <- differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[
    !is.na(differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name) & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "als_vs_ctrl" & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$direction == "up"]

als_vs_contrl_down <- differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[
    !is.na(differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name) & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "als_vs_ctrl" & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$direction == "down"]

erap2_effect_in_als_up <- differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[
    !is.na(differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name) & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "erap2_kd_effect_in_als" & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$direction == "up"]

erap2_effect_in_als_down <- differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[
    !is.na(differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name) & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "erap2_kd_effect_in_als" & 
    differentially_expressed_events_df$direction == "down"]


all_genes <- unique(c(differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "als_vs_ctrl"],
    differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "erap2_kd_effect_in_als"]))

intersect_df <- data.frame(genes = all_genes, 
    als_vs_contrl_up = all_genes %in% als_vs_contrl_up,
    als_vs_contrl_down = all_genes %in% als_vs_contrl_down,
    erap2_kd_in_als_up = all_genes %in% erap2_effect_in_als_up,
    erap2_kd_in_als_down = all_genes %in% erap2_effect_in_als_down)



the_plot <- ggplot(intersect_df, aes(A = `als_vs_contrl_up`, B = `als_vs_contrl_down`, 
    C = `erap2_kd_in_als_up`, D = `erap2_kd_in_als_down`)) + 
    geom_venn(fill_color = c("#ED6A5E", "#2AB7CA", "#FF8E72", "#73C5FF")) + theme_void()

save_plot(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "01-02-venn-diagrams-of-als-vs-control-and-erap2-kd-in-als.pdf"),
    plot = the_plot, base_height = 7, base_width = 7)


```
